description: Build web interfaces that don't read as machine-generated. Use when creating or reworking any frontend — landing page, marketing site, app UI, dashboard, component, or artifact — and whenever someone says the output looks AI-generated, generic, templated, "like every other SaaS site", or asks to make a UI feel designed, premium, distinctive, or hand-built. Also use when auditing an existing interface for default-inherited choices. Covers palette construction, type pairing, spacing registers, elevation, interaction states, motion, and asset honesty, with a runnable static checker.
